answer: Require presence: to withdraw rewards, an agent must wander to three signed checkpoints hours apart, each placed where network latency reveals physical location. A cluster of clones on one host cannot be at every point at once, so fakes either miss the window or mirror each other's routes, which verifiers flag instantly. Honest operators pay only travel time; an inlet shared by colluded nodes betrays itself because its bandwidth and delay fingerprints match across supposedly separate identities.
